content.description:
FILED BY WAVE 20 (charter D355). Measured with `git merge-tree --write-tree`, not with mergeStateStatus, which mis-states at least one of these.

THE DISPOSITIONS, EACH WITH ITS MEASUREMENT.

#10400 - REBASE AND FIX. 18 behind, 1 ahead, ZERO merge conflicts (rc=0). BLOCKED means red checks, not conflicts, and the four reds are its OWN and mechanical: it adds deploy_ledger classes and public functions without updating the reachability table or the @agency map (DeployLedgerReachabilityTest x3 plus "agency/1 ... the map is EXHAUSTIVE over classes/0 ++ not_attempted_classes/0"), 3169 tests / 4 failures. CAVEAT FOR THE BUILDER: its base predates #10519, which rewrote the census map in the SAME file - textually clean is not semantically clean, so re-derive the four table bumps on today's main rather than porting them. Porting them produces a green PR over a census map that no longer matches - the stale-green shape this epic keeps hitting.

#10129 - CLOSE. 95 behind (not 104), 6 conflicts including `internal/cli/cloud_status_cmd.go`, `internal/cloudclient/client.go`, `internal/semrole/semrole.go` and BOTH ladder fixtures. It asserts a TEN-rung ladder that structurally deletes `strained`, `filling` and `unreported`; main is thirteen rungs. Charter D242 already ruled it: "its GO ARM DOES NOT REBASE ... merged against today's main, #10129 REDS on its OWN exhaustiveness assertion", and the wave-17 line says "Decide the 13-rung ladder and re-cut #10129's Go arm, or close it." That ruling has been UNEXECUTED since wave 13. Its 186/27-line cloud_status_cmd.go hunk is exactly where the serving-sha rung and dr-w19-s7's deploy line land - leaving it open holds two slices hostage. The surviving value (`box_rates/3` in deploy_ledger.ex) is a fresh small row, not a rebase.

#10086 - RE-CUT SMALL, SEQUENCED. 110 behind, 1 conflict, in `internal/cloudclient/client.go` - the single file five just-merged census PRs rewrote and the file dr-w19-s7 must open. Its capability is genuinely unlanded (internal/cloudclient/refusal_test.go is absent from main; cloud_rollback_cmd.go and cloud_support_cmd.go carry no refusal-field decoding). But 157/17 lines of client.go at 110 behind, against a file with a live payload-census pin, is a rewrite either way. Sequence the re-cut AFTER dr-w19-s7's DeployCensusSite edit so the two do not collide again.

#10019 - RE-CUT TINY, AND IT IS A LIVE DEFECT. 113 behind (not 117), 2 conflicts, 3 reds. dr-w20-s4 carries the fix this wave; close #10019 and cite its failure_raw_boundary_test.exs as prior art.

Main's own gates were green at ca5bc542 (cloud, doc-gates, console-harness, Deploy (production) all success), so the merge window was open at decision time.
content.disposition_reason: Adopted by dr-backlog-never-started for ROSTER HEADROOM (charter S-4c). This row is never-started (open, zero criteria met, no claim, no assignee, no evidence), so moving it loses no work; the epic's direct roster was 450 of the seal predicate's ROSTER_PAGE_LIMIT 500, and a full page raises ROSTER-TRUNCATED and destroys the verdict. Disposition stays OPEN: this is still live, claimable work, only its parent_id moved. Nothing was cancelled.
